module handshake_deadline (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       i_ce,      // global enable / idle condition
    input  wire       start,     // upstream wants a parse burst
    input  wire       done,      // target signals completion early
    output wire       req,
    output wire       ack,
    output wire       busy_o,
    output wire       timeout
);
    // four-phase handshake: IDLE -> REQ (req rises) -> ACK (ack rises)
    //                       -> DROP (req drops) -> IDLE (ack drops)
    localparam [1:0] P_IDLE = 2'd0,
                     P_REQ  = 2'd1,
                     P_ACK  = 2'd2,
                     P_DROP = 2'd3;

    reg [1:0] phase = P_IDLE;   // handshake phase
    reg       busy  = 1'b0;     // mirrors the phase by construction
    reg [2:0] cnt   = 3'd4;     // completion deadline countdown

    assign req    = (phase == P_REQ)  || (phase == P_ACK);
    assign ack    = (phase == P_ACK)  || (phase == P_DROP);
    assign busy_o = busy;

    // the deadline has expired while the engine is still engaged
    assign timeout = busy && (cnt == 3'd0);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (i_ce) begin
            case (phase)
                P_IDLE: begin
                    if (start) begin
                        phase <= P_REQ;   // req rises
                        busy  <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
                P_REQ: begin
                    // req may not drop here; the target must raise ack first.
                    // the deadline forces the ack phase on the last tick,
                    // so the countdown can never run through zero.
                    if (done || cnt <= 3'd1)
                        phase <= P_ACK;   // ack rises
                    else
                        cnt   <= cnt - 3'd1;
                end
                P_ACK: begin
                    phase <= P_DROP;      // req drops, ack still high
                end
                P_DROP: begin
                    phase <= P_IDLE;      // ack drops
                    busy  <= 1'b0;
                    cnt   <= 3'd4;        // rearm the deadline
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // P1: the completion deadline never expires while the engine is engaged
    always @(posedge clk)
        assert (!timeout);

    // P2: while a request is outstanding the deadline is a live value
    always @(posedge clk)
        if (phase == 2'd1)
            assert (cnt >= 3'd1 && cnt <= 3'd4);
endmodule

true of the design but the set is NOT provable by k-induction on its own: a
prover starting from an arbitrary state can violate at least one of them.

module lefdef_parse_fsm (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       rst,
    input  wire       ce,
    input  wire [1:0] tok,
    output reg  [2:0] state,
    output reg        hdr_seen,
    output reg  [3:0] macro_cnt
);
    // binary-encoded parser FSM; encodings 3'd6 and 3'd7 are never entered
    localparam S_IDLE   = 3'd0;  // waiting for a file
    localparam S_HEADER = 3'd1;  // VERSION / UNITS block
    localparam S_MACRO  = 3'd2;  // MACRO record
    localparam S_PINS   = 3'd3;  // PIN records of current macro
    localparam S_LAYER  = 3'd4;  // LAYER / PORT geometry
    localparam S_END    = 3'd5;  // END LIBRARY

    initial state     = S_IDLE;
    initial hdr_seen  = 1'b0;    // shadow register: header block was parsed
    initial macro_cnt = 4'd0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state     <= S_IDLE;
            hdr_seen  <= 1'b0;
            macro_cnt <= 4'd0;
        end else if (ce) begin
            case (state)
                S_IDLE: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd1)
                        state <= S_HEADER;
                end
                S_HEADER: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd2) begin
                        hdr_seen <= 1'b1;   // header fully consumed
                        state    <= S_MACRO;
                    end
                end
                S_MACRO: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd3)
                        state <= S_PINS;
                    else if (tok == 2'd0)
                        state <= S_END;
                end
                S_PINS: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd3)
                        state <= S_LAYER;
                end
                S_LAYER: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd0) begin
                        state     <= S_MACRO;
                        macro_cnt <= macro_cnt + 4'd1;
                    end
                end
                S_END: begin
                    if (tok == 2'd1)
                        state <= S_IDLE;
                end
                default: begin
                    // illegal encoding recovery path (never taken in practice)
                    state <= S_PINS;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // Precedence: pin records can only be seen after the header was parsed.
    always @(posedge clk)
        if (state == S_PINS)
            assert (hdr_seen);
endmodule

immediate assertions - count them; a design with sub-modules may carry an
assertion inside a sub-module as well as one at the top. Every assertion is

// Tracks in-flight requests in an 8-deep shift register, with a separate
// running count of how many slots are currently occupied.
module inflight_tracker (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       step,     // pipeline advance / idle when low
    input  wire       issue,    // a new request enters slot 0 on this step
    output reg  [7:0] shift,    // occupancy of pipeline slots 0..7
    output reg  [3:0] count,    // number of occupied slots
    output wire       retire,   // request leaving the last slot this step
    output wire       busy
);

    initial shift = 8'b0000_0000;
    initial count = 4'd0;

    assign retire = step && shift[7];
    assign busy   = (count != 4'd0);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (step) begin
            shift <= {shift[6:0], issue};
            count <= count + (issue ? 4'd1 : 4'd0) - (shift[7] ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
        end
    end

    // P: whenever the occupancy count reads zero, no slot may hold a request.
    always @(*)
        assert (count != 4'd0 || shift == 8'b0000_0000);

endmodule

module handshake_deadline (
    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       i_ce,      // global enable / idle condition
    input  wire       start,     // upstream wants a parse burst
    input  wire       done,      // target signals completion early
    output wire       req,
    output wire       ack,
    output wire       busy_o,
    output wire       timeout
);
    // four-phase handshake: IDLE -> REQ (req rises) -> ACK (ack rises)
    //                       -> DROP (req drops) -> IDLE (ack drops)
    localparam [1:0] P_IDLE = 2'd0,
                     P_REQ  = 2'd1,
                     P_ACK  = 2'd2,
                     P_DROP = 2'd3;

    reg [1:0] phase = P_IDLE;   // handshake phase
    reg       busy  = 1'b0;     // mirrors the phase by construction
    reg [2:0] cnt   = 3'd4;     // completion deadline countdown
    reg [2:0] used  = 3'd0;     // enabled cycles this burst has been engaged
    reg       drain = 1'b0;     // extra busy cycle after a full-budget burst

    assign req    = (phase == P_REQ)  || (phase == P_ACK);
    assign ack    = (phase == P_ACK)  || (phase == P_DROP);
    assign busy_o = busy || drain;  // hold busy one cycle longer after a slow burst

    // the deadline has expired while the engine is still engaged
    assign timeout = busy && (cnt == 3'd0);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (i_ce) begin
            case (phase)
                P_IDLE: begin
                    drain <= 1'b0;
                    if (start) begin
                        phase <= P_REQ;   // req rises
                        busy  <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
                P_REQ: begin
                    // req may not drop here; the target must raise ack first.
                    // the deadline forces the ack phase on the last tick,
                    // so the countdown can never run through zero.
                    if (done || cnt <= 3'd1)
                        phase <= P_ACK;   // ack rises
                    else
                        cnt   <= cnt - 3'd1;
                    used  <= used + 3'd1;   // charge the latency counter
                end
                P_ACK: begin
                    phase <= P_DROP;      // req drops, ack still high
                    used  <= used + 3'd1;
                end
                P_DROP: begin
                    phase <= P_IDLE;      // ack drops
                    busy  <= 1'b0;
                    cnt   <= 3'd4;        // rearm the deadline
                    used  <= 3'd0;
                    drain <= (used >= 3'd5); // burst ate the whole budget
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // P1: the completion deadline never expires while the engine is engaged
    always @(posedge clk)
        assert (!timeout);

    // P2: while a request is outstanding the deadline is a live value
    always @(posedge clk)
        if (phase == 2'd1)
            assert (cnt >= 3'd1 && cnt <= 3'd4);

    // P3: a burst never stays engaged longer than the budget plus the ack tail
    always @(posedge clk)
        if (busy)
            assert (used <= 3'd5);
endmodule
